section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Planetary Gear Output Shaft)
title: Planetary Gear Output Shaft

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing all components of the planetary gear output shaft assembly in order of assembly

content.text: DISASSEMBLY OF PLANETARY GEAR OUTPUT SHAFT

content.description: Illustration showing hands grasping and removing components from the front end of the output shaft

items:
REMOVE NO. 3 BRAKE DISC/PLATE PACK AND FRONT PLANETARY PINION GEARS
Grasp the components and pull off the front end of the output shaft.
Be careful to avoid dropping the bearing on the output shaft.

REMOVE THRUST WASHER FROM PLANETARY GEARS
NOTE: The thrust washer may have stuck to the inside of the planetary gear case.
REMOVE BRAKE DISCS AND PLATES FROM PLANETARY GEARS
REMOVE REACTION PLATE FROM PLANETARY GEARS
